title: C: State Machine
description: Implement a finite state machine using function pointers for a simple traffic light controller.

steps.title: Traffic Light FSM
steps.description: Define states: GREEN, YELLOW, RED. Implement a state machine where GREEN -> YELLOW (after 5s), YELLOW -> RED (after 2s), RED -> GREEN (after 5s). Simulate 6 transitions and print the state each time.
hints: Each state is a function pointer that returns the next state.
Use `typedef enum { GREEN, YELLOW, RED } State;`.

verification.failureMessage: Run the traffic light FSM through 6 transitions
